content.title: Why Analysts Are Rethinking the SoFi Story After Mixed but Upbeat Q3 Reactions
content.summary: SoFi Technologies' updated fair value estimate has inched up to approximately $27.15 from about $26.61, even as the discount rate nudged higher to roughly 8.02% from around 7.97%. This subtle recalibration reflects a tug of war between bullish views that Q3 execution and loan platform scaling warrant higher long term earnings assumptions and more cautious voices focused on macro risks, slowing growth comps, and a less favorable risk reward profile at current valuations.
